description:
Your workouts and your food, in one app.

Kinetta brings activity tracking, food logging and progress together. Record or import your workouts, save meals you make often, and share the activities you choose.

WORKOUTS
Record outdoor runs, walks and rides with GPS on iPhone. Time indoor activities, log lifting sets and reps, or follow a running plan. Review maps, splits, heart rate and other details when your recording or import provides them.

FOOD
Search for foods, scan a barcode or enter nutrition yourself. Save recipes and choose the portion you ate. Follow calories, protein and other recorded nutrients. Missing nutrition stays unknown rather than becoming zero.

PROGRESS
Compare your distance and time across weeks, months and years. Log weigh-ins and follow your weight trend. View food and training summaries together. Estimates depend on the records available and are not medical advice.

FRIENDS
Find friends, cheer their activities and leave comments. Choose Only me, Friends or Everyone for each activity. Shared routes trim the start and end using your privacy settings; the remaining route can still reveal location clues. Your food entries, weigh-ins and private notes are not shared.

OPTIONAL CONNECTIONS AND AI
Apple Health imports need your permission, and you choose which supported categories to connect. Kit offers optional AI help when it is available for your account. Turn it on before sending relevant records or food descriptions and photos to the configured AI provider; Health and Garmin data have separate choices. Review food estimates and proposed changes before confirming them.

Kinetta is for people 16 or older. Kit is for people 18 or older. An account on a Kinetta server is required; enrollment and optional services depend on that server. Some recording and Apple Health features require the iPhone app. You can export your data or delete your account in Settings.
